falsification_contract.TREATMENT: Apply a salt-repellent (anti-fouling) coating to the blade airfoil surface that blocks salt crystal retention, thereby lowering ice adhesion strength so ice sheds under high wind loads, and schedule de-icing cycles preferentially toward the warmer end of the −3 °C~−15 °C operating window where adhesion is reduced.
falsification_contract.CONTROL_BLOCKER: no executed baseline comparison on record (physics chain executed: ['PRE_REQUIREMENTS']; lifecycle MECHANISM_NOT_SIMULATABLE) — the control arm is not invented from the problem statement
